context: Yuki visits Naoko's new country home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 直子さん、田舎、いい雰囲気。
lines.en: Naoko-san, your place out here has such a lovely feeling to it.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried opening. Soft genuineness in the voice — not performing, noticing. Gentle exhale on the observation. The gratitude of being welcomed lands lightly.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ゆきちゃん、来てくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Yuki-chan, I'm so glad you came.
lines.style: Immediate warmth, no hesitation. Voice opens up on the greeting. Tender undercurrent — the kind of happiness that comes from someone you care about showing up. Lingering softness on the close.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 友達、ずっと、繋がってる、嬉しい。
lines.en: Being able to stay connected with you like this — it makes me really happy.
lines.style: Sincere and steady. Voice carries the weight of meaning without strain. Slight emphasis on the continuity. Trailing off gently, like she's saying something she means deeply.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 一緒に、お茶、飲みましょう。
lines.style: Inviting without pressure. Warm, hospitable tone that feels like an extension of care. Slight lift on the offer — the pleasure of including someone in this small moment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: Tell me — how was your time abroad?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward slightly. Bright but unhurried. The attention is real — not filling space, but inviting her to share. Openness in the delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Contented, almost surprised by her own joy. Simple and honest. The warmth of someone who loves spending time with the person in front of her, no filter needed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: You really are such a precious friend to me.
lines.style: Vulnerable and unguarded. Voice softens deeper here — this is the thing that matters, and she's saying it plainly. No performance, just truth. Quiet, steady, held.
